provider_error_response.body: The API refused the connection's credentials (401). Its message is hidden for security. Check api_key.

errors.meaning: No turn key, or the Ingress gate did not stamp an identity.
CUSTOM_API_GATEWAY__ENABLED is off on this deployment.
The body is not exactly this shape, or the path, query or headers are refused (including any that carry the turn key); nothing was sent.
auth will not resolve this connection for this turn key, its stored auth section no longer passes the shared rules, or a value it places is over 8 KiB or its scrub set over 1.5 MiB.
auth or the call-rate store could not be asked, or auth answered another binding.
The saved origin is refused, or its host resolves to an address that is not public.
The API answered with a Content-Encoding other than identity.
The call outlasted its 20 s deadline.

The answer body is over 1 MiB, or echoes connection values so densely that removing them would pass the scrub's budget: each hit costs about six times its form's length plus 128, and all hits of all forms together may cost at most 32 times the bytes searched (the body, or a client error's excerpt window; at least 64 KiB), beyond one search per form. Nothing of the answer is returned.
The grant's calls for this 60 s window, auth's resolve rate, or the open calls allowed for this connection, this turn or this process are used up.
The host did not resolve or the send failed.
